title: Ahijah
summary: Raleigh names Ahijah in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ahijah, the father of Baasha. He is not the Prophet Ahijah. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IX, §. II, sig. 238a
